purpose: Discovery-only additional European building observations, national registers, energy certificates, heights, roof equipment, address IDs and cross-country links to enrich EUBUCCO; rights/science/admission never implied.

entries.name: TUM GlobalBuildingAtlas ODbL building polygon subset
entries.provider: Technical University of Munich / Zhu Lab
entries.spatial_scope: Worldwide, quality and completeness geographically variable
entries.temporal_scope: GlobalBuildingAtlas 2025 release; upstream source vintage varies
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Part GBA.ODbLPolygon only: building footprints from ODbL-licensed sources, separate from commercial-restricted 3D height products; building geometry stored as EPSG:3857 per publisher
entries.note: Important: the separate GBA.Polygon, GBA.LoD1 and GBA.Height datasets are CC BY-NC 4.0. Publisher warns some files appear tagged EPSG:4326 but should be interpreted as EPSG:3857. Check per-file CRS and OSM/Microsoft shared lineage; this polygon subset is not independently observed or an all-building census.

entries.name: TUM GlobalBuildingAtlas LoD1 and height model (noncommercial)
entries.provider: Technical University of Munich / Zhu Lab
entries.spatial_scope: Worldwide, spatially variable height quality and missing features
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Level-of-detail-1 building volumes and GBA.Height data, derived by ML and footprint fusion
entries.note: Separate from ODbL polygons because GBA.LoD1/GBA.Height are CC BY-NC 4.0. Research evaluation alone does not authorize incorporation into operational commercial (re)insurance CAT models, nor redistribute derived 3D features. No provider web-viewer automation or feature streaming per explicit terms.

entries.name: 3D-GloBFP Europe building footprints with heights v1
entries.provider: Che, Li, Liu and collaborators / Zenodo
entries.spatial_scope: European countries including non-EU Europe in country bundles
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Country-group RAR bundles of vector shapefiles with individual polygon height attributes (~20.8GB total)
entries.note: Publisher declares CC BY 4.0; release bundles are large and height estimates model-derived, not direct LiDAR field measurements. Select small bounded country/area after documenting RAR extraction, height units, CRS, matching, height uncertainty and possible overlapping model inputs.

entries.name: Estonia Ehitisregister (EHR) open building register, geometries and certificates
entries.provider: Estonian e-Construction platform / Land and Spatial Development Board
entries.temporal_scope: Daily updated public extraction, historical records from 1994
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Building objects and use categories, entrances, permits, occupancy, technical construction attributes, energy certificates and cadastral links
entries.note: Verified data descriptions via University of Tartu open-data overview. Distinguish buildings from apartment units and entrances, current/completed from planned/demolished. Check original source open-data license, coordinate CRS, exact IDs/geometry and personal/address fields before any import; use the official API instead of scraping site pages.

entries.name: TalTech expert-validated Estonian apartment archetype and materials data
entries.spatial_scope: Estonian Soviet-era mass apartment housing sample
entries.resolution_or_granularity: EHR-coded apartment buildings with year, roof, wall, storeys, staircase and floor-area properties; archetype material intensities and panel counts
entries.note: Highly useful small expert-labelled reference. Not a nationwide random building sample; Soviet mass-housing focus creates strong selection bias. Keep EHR_code only when lawful and nonidentifying; verify actual source of each reported value. Material intensities derive from archival standard-design passports, not destructive material surveys of each building.

entries.name: GeoE3 cross-border Buildings 2D OGC API collections
entries.provider: GeoE3 European location-services consortium / National Land Survey Finland
entries.spatial_scope: Multi-country API collections: Estonia, Finland, Netherlands, Norway, Spain, France, Slovenia
entries.temporal_scope: Service snapshots and member feeds are mutable
entries.resolution_or_granularity: OGC API Features harmonised access to national building polygon/reference collections
entries.note: Gateway republishes national authorities' information and is NOT an independent building-survey source. Each collection requires its own service terms, access limits, country-specific content/version and original license; do not confuse harmonised schema with harmonised rights.

entries.name: France IGN LiDAR HD classified point-cloud tiles
entries.provider: Institut national de l'information géographique et forestière
entries.spatial_scope: Metropolitan France and listed overseas regions as acquisition progresses; map availability per tile
entries.temporal_scope: 2026 source update; survey dates vary across acquisition blocks
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Classified LAZ 1.4 or COPC tiles with ground/building/vegetation classes, 1km² tiles often 0.5–2GB; >=10 laser shots/m² typical under 3200m
entries.note: Official French data portal states Licence Ouverte v2.0, but check exact tile and attribution. Cloud acquisition may precede latest footprint; huge tile volumes. Convert vertical reference before height comparison; do not mistake roof altitude for ground-relative building height. Coverage expected by 2026 is not guaranteed complete on 2026-11-01.

entries.name: Germany NRW Geobasis 3D laser measurement point clouds (3DM)
entries.temporal_scope: Continuous regional acquisition with heterogeneous campaigns; planned increased density end-2026 onward
entries.resolution_or_granularity: LAS/LAZ airborne point clouds with return class, intensity, GPS timestamp and ground/surface distinction
entries.note: Capture exact acquisition tile, original CRS/horizontal and vertical reference, point density and measurement date. Not direct construction year or material. Do not assume planned 2027 enhanced point density exists in current historical tiles.

entries.name: Switzerland swissSURFACE3D national LiDAR classified point cloud
entries.provider: Swiss Federal Office of Topography swisstopo
entries.spatial_scope: Switzerland and Liechtenstein, nationally available since 2024
entries.temporal_scope: Mixed acquisition years; new COPC/LAZ types since 2024
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Georeferenced classified XYZ points for buildings, bare earth and vegetation, generally 1 km² tiles
entries.note: Distinct raw observation layer versus already catalogued swissBUILDINGS3D 3.0 derived model; may share raw LiDAR processing and is not independent of the derived model. Swiss vertical datum and EGID building linkage need review.

entries.name: Slovenia official real estate cadastre building layer INSPIRE WFS
entries.provider: Surveying and Mapping Authority of the Republic of Slovenia (GURS)
entries.temporal_scope: Maintained real estate cadastre, metadata from 2022 and updates thereafter
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Building polygons and cadastral parcels in national D96/TM (EPSG:3794) via WFS/WMS and cadastral records
entries.note: INSPIRE building polygons are not automatically freely bulk redistributable; examine specific WFS schema/terms and cadastral identification separately. Map provider feature identifiers to durable local IDs with type/geometry and snapshot preservation.

entries.name: Madrid Autonomous Community Energy Efficiency Certificate Register (CEEE)
entries.spatial_scope: Madrid autonomous region, certified residential and other buildings
entries.temporal_scope: Year-scoped public CSV downloads, monthly current-year updates incl 2026
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Certificates with heating/cooling, energy rating, date and selected building construction/system characteristics
entries.note: Certificate scope may be a dwelling or building, many vintages per real property, missing exact cadastral IDs; do not treat as exhaustive housing stock or a direct structural material survey. Avoid over-linking raw addresses to individuals; check original source licence and matched spatial precision.

entries.name: Lombardy regional CENED+2.0 Energy Performance Certificates
entries.temporal_scope: Rolling certification data; published version varies by dataset
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Public datasets with building location context, energy rating, geometric characteristics, systems and renewable-energy use
entries.note: APE certificate is a property/dwelling observation, not necessarily whole-building identity. Multiple certificates across time create duplicated buildings. Preserve valid year, status, cadastral/address match and source entity granularity; do not infer structural vulnerability from energy performance alone.

entries.name: Germany Marktstammdatenregister public rooftop solar unit inventory
entries.spatial_scope: Germany nationwide with privacy-restricted site precision
entries.temporal_scope: Daily public XML full extract and dated snapshots; new export structure October 2025
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Public registered solar units by commissioning time, capacity and site fields subject to data protection
entries.note: Official register withholds street/house number and geocoordinates of solar installations <=30kWp and other natural-person details. It MUST NOT be reverse-geocoded to individual homes via external datasets. Match only lawful published precise sites or aggregate by geography; do not treat PV capacity as insured replacement amount. Full XML extract ~3GB zipped as of 2026-11-01.

entries.name: France Base Adresse Nationale (BAN) official geocoded address dataset
entries.provider: French national reference addresses / IGN and local authorities
entries.temporal_scope: Daily per-department published files; latest directory updated October 2026
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Addresses with stable BAN identifiers and geocoded representative points in CSV, national reference service
entries.note: An address point is NOT a building centroid, and a building can contain many addresses; do not create false one-to-one building IDs or retain owner/occupant details. Legacy api-adresse.data.gouv.fr endpoint deprecated, use modern Geoplateforme or official downloadable files, version and coordinate CRS.

entries.name: Hotmaps EU heat demand and gross floor area density raster references
entries.spatial_scope: EU28 and selected neighbouring countries incl Switzerland Norway Iceland
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 100m x 100m heat-density/finished floor-area and housing-category raster datasets, plus downloadable model data repositories
entries.note: Heat demand and floor area are modelled from stock data, not individual building records. 2015 data are temporally stale; avoid exact building assignment. Use only aggregated catchment/grid validation, accounting for source duplication with Eurostat national building statistics.

entries.name: Ordnance Survey NGD roof geometry/attributes (restricted product)
entries.spatial_scope: Great Britain; provider reports coverage of more than 40 million roofs
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Detailed roof mapping products in OS National Geographic Database intended for commercial/geospatial workflows
entries.note: Keep discovery only: OS NGD roof attributes should not be confused with free OS OpenMap Local and OS Open UPRN. Before any use, purchase/contract/rights and data licensing review; do not claim free download or derive user-facing roof models from proprietary source.
